anchor.semantic_hook: The literal idea of doing something for it to count or be worth it becomes a physical weighing of each activity on a value scale before it is accepted as genuine.

One colossal working balance scale rises through the middle of the hall, with a room-sized pan ready to receive the objects from every serious undertaking. All other furnishings and equipment are ordinary.

The single track continues past the floor, climbs the rear wall, and crosses the ceiling while keeping every tray upright and directly behind the preceding tray. Ordinary storage shelves line the remaining walls.
